title: Christ Church Cathedral (Fredericton)
geometryBasis: The mapped 34-point cathedral outline supplies the net outer walls, with native roof parts recording the nave and sanctuary axes and the exact octagonal spire footprint.
sectionBasis: The cathedral records the current spire at 198 feet, equivalent to 60.35 m. Ground is sampled from the frozen west approach. Mapped component heights and the released exact photo guide the wall-to-roof proportions.
limitations: The cathedral’s east elevation, tower and sanctuary are based on the verified Qualla viewpoint. Windows and doors on less documented elevations approximate the materials and shapes of the current building.
The wall height, leaded glass motifs, pinnacles, roof trim and discrete approach landing heights are estimated.
The adjacent parish hall, trees and interiors are outside the exterior model.
